correctness.rationale: Exact finite-category sign-kernel enumeration gives parent tau -5/18 and ordered-pair tau -1/2 for a smooth compact-bump exchangeable mixture. Independent-copy coupling changes their difference by at most 4(2η−η²) for η=1/100, proving strict gap ≥3209/22500 after adding a smooth strictly positive exponential density. A case analysis of sorted endpoint differences proves the two-coordinate pointwise Kendall inequality for all real pairs, including ties. Actual embedded Python checker verifies all rational identities; finite diagnostics do not replace universal arguments.

originality.rationale: Inspected Kochar–Spizzichino full HTML sections and archival preprint description: their theorem holds under restricted time-transformed exponential models and explicitly proposes extension to other exchangeable laws. Exact counterexample to that proposed unrestricted extension is not contained therein. Two closest publicly available mathematical records inspected in full address pairwise-independent labeled ordering laws and iid discrete Pearson min-max correlation, neither covering Kendall comparison for finitely exchangeable triples. Targeted published-finding corpus queries and prior research ledgers returned no equivalent statement. Full-text access to Fuchs–Schmidt 2021 could not be established; earlier terminology could conceal overlap, a disclosed bibliographic risk.
residual_risks: Fuchs–Schmidt (2021) full text could not be inspected after OA and institutional-access attempts; possible earlier equivalent construction remains a priority risk.
Equivalent results may appear under alternative concordance-order or reliability terminology not captured by semantic searches.
The positive theorem’s stronger dependence order is model-specific; we refute only a claimed unrestricted Kendall implication, not its special-case proof.

value.rationale: Resolves a natural extension explicitly invited by Kochar–Spizzichino, using a minimal sample-size-three construction. Smooth full-support density and robust rational gap demonstrate the obstruction is structural, not discrete singular support. The universal sample-size-two rearrangement inequality gives a sharp boundary. This is a motivated positive/negative dependence distinction useful for exchangeable reliability models, not a normalization check or arbitrary parameter slice.
